SCOPE TRANSPARENCY

Clarity about what’s included matters.

Not every integration belongs in every project. We distinguish core development work from optional technologies requiring separate approval.

Talk through the scope
Core project work

Approved web design, frontend/backend features and launch deliverables as specified in your written proposal.

Optional third-party services

AI APIs, CRMs, chat tools, email providers, paid hosting or automation platforms may need credentials and subscriptions.

Production verification

All real data connections, permissions, workflows and customer-facing behaviors require testing before launch.
